question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Demolish
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"demolish"** means to** destroy or tear down** a building or structure completely. (ध्वस्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The old factory was **demolished** to make way for new apartments.
 
 
 
• **"Construct" **means to build or put together a building or structure. (निर्माण करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company plans to** construct** a new office building next year.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'demolish' **is **'construct'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Invite** (आमंत्रित करना): To ask someone to come to a social event or to participate in something.

 
 
• **Example:** We** invited** all our friends to the party.
 
 
 
• **Criticise** (आलोचना करना): To express disapproval of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **It is not fair to **criticise **someone without knowing the full story.
 
 
 
• **Appreciate** (प्रशंसा करना): To recognize the full worth of something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** I** appreciate** all the hard work you have done.
